correctness.rationale: A degree-5 Artin–Schreier cover with one order-four pole has genus 6 and a unique rational point at infinity. Exact full-field enumeration for n=1 through 6 independently via direct Artin–Schreier images and trace-zero fibres yields 6,6,156,646,3501,15576; Newton identities and Weil functional equation produce the listed 12-degree numerator. Full modular Rabin irreducibility checks modulo 2 establish irreducibility over Q, hence F5-simplicity; integer trial division certifies 11731 prime, hence a prime-order cyclic rational Jacobian. The bundled verifier reproduces every input and output. No geometric simplicity or extension of this model is assumed.
